title: Looking for a full day?!!
text:
What an amazing day!!  We were picked up on time,  told what to expect and off we went.   Javier was an excellent resource of knowledge and was able to answer our questions.  He kept us moving and on time for each sight.

The walk and views around Girona were breathtaking and we could not have asked for better weather.  

Upon our arrival to the winery we were greeted and shown around the vines and walked through the wine making process.  In Texas hill country we have lots of wineries but nothing as cute and quaint as Vins de Taller.

title: Excellent.  Couldn't be better. So happy
text: We had the best day. So memorable and beautiful.  Toni Is a wonderful guide. He was friendly and attentive and extremely cheerful and a nice person. We are very grateful we spent the day with him . Girona was gorgeous..the wine tour was oh so lovely and the dali musuem awesome. Book without hesitation and ask for toni if you can

title: Fantastic Tour of Costa Brava
text: Excellent tour of Costa Brava with wine and tapas, and the Dali Museum. Javi was a fantastic tour guide. It was a great day!
author: shellysn

title: Excellent Tour!
text: We had a fantastic time on our private tour of Costa Brava, with tapas and wine tasting as well as touring the Dali Museum. Javi was an amazing guide throughout the day with a lot of information about the region. It was a nice, relaxing day along the coast, and the wine tasting and tapas were excellent. Highly recommend.
author: Shelly_N

title: Montserrat excursion tour & wine tasting.
text:
Experience of a lifetime.
Gus Celis knows his business. Very knowledgeable, & very informative.
He is a professional tour guide.
author: winstons703

title: Best day trip of our Barcelona vacation!
text: This day trip from Barcelona had something for everyone in my family of 5- Pol was a wonderful tour guide and an excellent driver! He adjusted for our needs and provided good history and information about each of our stops! The   Museum wasn’t my cup of tea, but my husband and son loved it- then to the lovely town of Parafruguell for lunch. Pol couldn’t find close parking to show us around, so he dropped us close to the restaurant and we were able to walk a bit, and 2 of my kids fit in a swim.
